notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
The Dryad Arbor token enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Lotus Cobra.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing the Dryad Arbor token.
The Dryad Arbor token dies, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.
